query: What was the Revenue from Operations and EBITDA margin in Q2 FY27 compared to Q1 FY27?
ground_truth_answer: Revenue from Operations in Q2 FY27 reached 1,250.5 Cr compared to 1,180.0 Cr in Q1 FY27 (+5.9% QoQ) [Source: TataElxsi_Q2.pdf | Page: 12 | Chunk: TATAELXSI_Q2_FY27_p12_c01]. EBITDA for Q2 FY27 stood at 355.5 Cr against 330.1 Cr in Q1 FY27 [Source: TataElxsi_Q2.pdf | Page: 12 | Chunk: TATAELXSI_Q2_FY27_p12_c01].

query: What is the revised capex guidance for FY28 and what is it allocated for?
ground_truth_answer: Management revised the capex guidance for FY28 to 200 Cr, primarily allocated toward expanding the Bangalore development center and setting up GPU computing clusters [Source: TataElxsi_Q2_Concall.pdf | Page: 15 | Chunk: TATAELXSI_Q2_FY27_p15_c02].

query: How did the Transportation segment perform in Q2 FY27 in terms of revenue and QoQ growth?
ground_truth_answer: The Transportation vertical reported revenue of 512 Cr representing +4.4% QoQ expansion, driven by software-defined vehicles (SDV) contracts [Source: TataElxsi_Q2.pdf | Page: 14 | Chunk: TATAELXSI_Q2_FY27_p14_c03].

query: What was the Healthcare division revenue and growth rate in Q2 FY27?
ground_truth_answer: The Healthcare division delivered revenue of 120 Cr with +4.3% QoQ growth across digital health platforms [Source: TataElxsi_Q2.pdf | Page: 16 | Chunk: TATAELXSI_Q2_FY27_p16_c04].

query: Did operating ROCE expand or contract between Q1 FY27 and Q2 FY27?
ground_truth_answer: Operating ROCE expanded by 230 bps from 34.2% in Q1 FY27 [Source: TataElxsi_Q1.pdf | Page: 5 | Chunk: TATAELXSI_Q1_FY27_p05_c01] to 36.5% in Q2 FY27 [Source: TataElxsi_Q2.pdf | Page: 12 | Chunk: TATAELXSI_Q2_FY27_p12_c01].
